commonDescription:
Parses a date and formats it as a string. A single argument is interpreted as milliseconds since the
Unix epoch; other forms parse an input pattern and may specify input and output time zones.
commonReturnDescription: The formatted date string, or an empty sequence if parsing or formatting fails.
name: format-date

args.description: The number of milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
args.name: milliseconds

signatures.description: Formats milliseconds since the Unix epoch in Stroom's standard date-time format.

args.description: The pattern describing the input date.
args.name: inputPattern

args.description: The input time zone; defaults to UTC. `GMT/BST` handles British Summer Time.
args.name: inputTimeZone

signatures.description: Parses a date string and returns Stroom's standard date-time format.

args.description: The pattern describing the input date.
args.name: inputPattern

args.description: The input time zone; defaults to UTC.
args.name: inputTimeZone

args.description: The pattern for the output string.
args.name: outputPattern

args.description: The output time zone; defaults to UTC.
args.name: outputTimeZone

signatures.description: Parses a date string and formats it with a custom output pattern.
